items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: One of my teachers was a descendent of the great Rafer Johnson... I remember he used to come up to the house... to give me a piano lesson

ctx.x: Well, then when you got into music at the very beginning, do you recall what age it was when you were --

Well, I began piano when I was about ten years old and I studied piano for four years. One of my teachers was a descendent of the great Rafer Johnson, the decathlon winner from some years ago at Antioch Collech in Yellow Springs, Ohio. I remember he used to come up to the house -- come all the way from Yellow Springs, nine miles, to give me a piano lesson, and charge me 50 cents. And I remember he drive his first car up to the house. It was a Ford; he paid $550.00 for it. And he was elated, so he could hardly…
What a thrill he had with his Ford.
